capabilities: Renames newly created files, replacing spaces with dashes
Scans and renames existing vault files on plugin load
Shows a notice for each file renamed
extras: The README notes the Community Plugin List submission is 'Coming soon'; installation is manual only.
problem: Obsidian allows spaces in file names, and users who prefer dash-separated names have to rename files manually.
summary: File-name plugin that automatically renames notes, replacing spaces in file names with dashes, both for new files and existing vault files.
